title: Vatican confiscated the Fatima prophecy

tellings.quote: Vatican confiscated one of the prophecies from the the uh orphans or whatever that uh you know made the prophecy

plain: After children at Fatima in Portugal delivered prophecies in 1917, the Vatican took one of those prophecies and kept it, Michels says. He tells it himself and loosely ("the orphans or whatever"), tying it to what are called the Secrets of Fatima. If it is true, the Church locked away a message it did not want made public.
